title: Move open (local) models behind an experimental flag and freeze them
description: User decision on 2026-10-09: open models are hard to manage well right now. Move everything related to them behind an experimental flag; unless it is on, nothing related to open models exists in the running app. Open-model development is frozen, freeing time for work such as ARA-088. The flag-off app uses only hosted OpenAI chat, embedding and reranking profiles. Lead check of the user's dev data: all 6 papers use the default OpenAI embedding profile and every assistant answer used a hosted model, so turning the flag off loses nothing.
acceptance_criteria: Given EXPERIMENTAL_OPEN_MODELS is unset or false (the default), when the app runs, then no open-model surface exists: no local chat models in /models or the composer, no Local models settings, no local embedding or reranker profiles, no model download, verify or delete endpoints or jobs, no local-model activity and no startup verification jobs.

Given the flag is off, when Compose starts with the documented command, then the Ollama and model-worker services do not run, readiness never depends on them, and existing model volumes and weights are untouched.
Given the flag is on, together with the documented Compose profile, when the app runs, then today's open-model behaviour returns unchanged.

Given stored state referencing open models (a saved local default, local-model history, a paper on a local embedding profile, a local reranker setting), when the flag is off, then history stays readable, nothing silently switches to a paid model, the user is asked to choose a hosted model, and retrieval settings resolve to hosted profiles.
Given the flag is off, when the backend and frontend suites run, then they pass, and the existing open-model tests still pass with the flag on in tests.
Given README and AGENTS.md, when read, then open models appear only in an Experimental section that states the freeze and how to enable them.
test_cases: Backend: catalogs, routes, jobs and readiness with the flag off and on.
Backend: a saved local default and a local retrieval profile with the flag off.
Frontend: settings, composer, Activity and Details hide open-model UI when the API reports the flag off.
Compose config check: profiles exclude ollama and model-worker by default.
verification: 2026-10-09 on feat/ara-090-open-models-flag in isolated project ara-flag-test. Backend: 998 passed (baseline, 184.64s) -> 1012 passed in 166.13s with Ruff clean (scripts/test-stack.py test). The 14 new tests in tests/test_open_models_flag.py first ran 13 failed, 1 passed (the readiness characterization), e.g. "AttributeError: 'Settings' object has no attribute 'experimental_open_models'", 'assert 202 == 404' for a model download, "assert 'hybrid' == 'keyword'" for a paper on Qwen3 and "assert 'qwen3-rerank-0.6b' is None" for the saved reranker. With the flag defaulting off, 99 existing open-model tests failed (OPEN_MODELS_DISABLED, missing local catalog rows); they now run unchanged with the flag on through the open_models marker (20 whole modules, 45 tests in 12 mixed modules); a hosted /models test supplies the saved default the route now reads. Frontend: npm run check passed with 538 tests in 73 files (530 existing + 8 new) and npm run build passed (existing >500 kB chunk warning). The 8 new UI tests first ran 7 failed, 1 passed (the flag-on case); 37 existing local-model UI tests then needed the feature reported on through a mocked GET /features, and one Activity empty-state test now expects the flag-off copy. Compose: tests/infrastructure 19 passed (15 existing + 4 new; the new ones failed 3 of 4 against the pre-change compose files). docker compose config --services lists no ollama/model-worker by default and both with --profile open-models or COMPOSE_PROFILES=open-models; the test stack pins EXPERIMENTAL_OPEN_MODELS=false, the browser stack sets it true and runs model-worker; scripts/test-stack.py config checks both states. Live flag-off test stack (scripts/test-stack.py up): api healthy without Ollama, /health/ready checks database/storage/redis only, GET /features {open_models:false}, /models and /retrieval/profiles hosted only, POST /models/{key}/download 404. OpenAPI: 32 paths flag off, 36 flag on (download, installation, pause, resume); generated.ts comes from the flag-on schema. Not run here: the Playwright suite (shared fixed ports; the browser stack now sets the flag on for the model specs) and a live flag-on stack with real Ollama weights; the user's ara stack was not touched. Merged feat/ux-feedback-round (7fb04ee: ARA-086/087/089/091) in aea2946. Conflicts: routes/retrieval.py (per-paper PUT dropped, ARA-091 prices kept with the hidden local install key, rebuild refused while the library model is local), SearchIndexPanel.tsx (ARA-091's panel, Build/Rebuild guard dropped), ProfileOptions.tsx (no 'Use default' row; local rows hidden or frozen, local price copy hidden while off), README (one Experimental section on top of ARA-087's text), the journal, and three backend and one frontend test renames. The per-paper flag test became a local-library-default test. New in 0155947: GET /retrieval/reindex-estimate returns 409 OPEN_MODELS_DISABLED for a local model while off (red first: 'assert (200 == 409)'), free with the flag on; ARA-091's mixed estimate test runs with the flag on. After the merge: backend 1013 passed in 192.73s, Ruff clean (one alembic DeprecationWarning from test_schema_revision.py); frontend npm run check 583 tests in 75 files (one ARA-091 react-refresh lint warning on priceLabel) and npm run build passed; tests/infrastructure 19 passed; live flag-off test stack: ready without Ollama, hosted-only catalogs (openai-3-large, openai-3-small, openai-gpt-6-luna), local estimate 409, model download 404. OpenAPI: 35 paths off, 39 on; generated.ts from the flag-on schema was unchanged by regeneration.
